title: Al-Kahf 18:1-5 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Tajweed mastery and Al-Kahf consolidation
source: Written for quran/y11 lesson 3 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Kahf 18:1-5 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 3. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عِوَجَا ۜ (١) قَيِّمًۭا لِّيُنذِرَ بَأْسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا مِّن لَّدُنْهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا (٢) مَّٰكِثِينَ فِيهِ أَبَدًۭا (٣) وَيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًۭا (٤) مَّا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍۢ وَلَا لِءَابَآئِهِمْ ۚ كَبُرَتْ كَلِمَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ ۚ إِن يَقُولُونَ إِلَّا كَذِبًۭا (٥)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, who has sent down upon His Servant the Book and has not made therein any deviance.
[He has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward
In which they will remain forever
And to warn those who say, "Allah has taken a son."
They have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers. Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths; they speak not except a lie.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Kahf 18:1-5 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 18:1-5 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 18:1-5 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: In the portal box, explain what 18:4 to 5 warn against.
questions.a: Saying that Allah has taken a son: a grave word without knowledge.

questions.q: Explain why the saktah protects the meaning of 18:1 to 2.
questions.a: Without it, قَيِّمًا could seem to describe 'deviance'; the pause makes clear 'straight' describes the Book.

options: A brief silent pause, no new breath
questions.a: A) A brief silent pause, no new breath. Saktah: a short pause without taking breath; it separates 'no deviance' from 'straight'.

questions.q: Think again: The Prophet ﷺ told us that memorising the first ten ayat of Al-Kahf protects from the Dajjal. Why might these ayat protect?
questions.a: They affirm the straight Book, the reward of believers and the warning against false claims about Allah: firm belief protects (18:1 to 5).
